During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''sector fleet''' patrolled the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]]. [[Starship/Legends|Ships]] from the [[Sector fleet/Legends|fleet]] occasionally swept through the [[Both system]] but rarely interfered with local [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] matters.
